description: Last week marked a significant uplift in the market valuation of five of the top 10 firms, appreciating by Rs 1.54 lakh crore. Tata Consultancy Services claimed the spotlight, boosting its valuation by Rs 72,072.3 crore. ICICI Bank and Reliance Industries also experienced notable increases. title: Axis Bank standalone profit soars 23% in Q1
description: Axis Bank on Saturday reported a 23% year-on-year increase in standalone quarterly net profit, aided by lower provisions, even as its pre-provision operating profit grew just 1.3%.

title: Kotak Bank Q1 net rises 26% on loan growth
description: Kotak Mahindra Bank experienced a remarkable net profit surge of twenty-six percent in the June quarter. This impressive growth can be attributed to a significant decline in provisions that bolstered the bank's financial results. Additionally, net interest income rose by nine percent, while operating profit saw a ten percent increase.

title: Yes Bank Q1 profit surges 34% on strong loan growth
description: Yes Bank has reported a remarkable thirty-four percent surge in net profit for the first quarter, driven by robust loan growth and enhancing net interest margins. The bank's loan portfolio expanded by eighteen percent, especially within corporate advances, while commercial banking loans rose by seventeen percent. The management is optimistic that this trend of positive loan growth will persist in the upcoming months.

title: ICICI Bank net profit jumps 16% YoY to Rs 14,805 crore
description: ICICI Bank reported a 15.9% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 14,805 crore, driven by healthy growth in net interest income, strong fee income and lower provisions. Net interest income increased 12.7% to Rs 24,384 crore, while fee income jumped 23.5%. The bank's net interest margin remained stable at 4.36% during the June quarter.

title: HDFC Bank logs 5% rise in profit on margin pressure
description: HDFC Bank announced a notable five percent rise in profits for the June quarter, showcasing a robust growth in net interest income. Despite facing margin pressures that led to a contraction, the bank achieved a remarkable fifteen percent increase in gross advances, largely fueled by business and corporate loans. Additionally, deposits grew significantly, indicating strong customer engagement and successful operating efficiency strategies during the period.
